oneLiner: Fantasy football for the Billboard charts, refereed by GenLayer.
description: Hot Roster is a fantasy music league for 4–8 friends. Draft five songs, play weekly head-to-head matches and earn code-calculated Hot 100 points. GenLayer validators independently match featured credits and versions against extracted chart rows, judge moment cards against frozen definitions, and resolve disputes against a hashed rulebook with verbatim evidence. Five distinct contracts separate judgment, league scoring and optional GEN pools. Finality callbacks, fixed deadlines, cached reads and resumable receipt manifests make progress inspectable. The app shows only rostered chart positions and permanent evidence links. A real six-week StudioNet replay is currently being verified; incomplete outcomes stay labelled pending. Simulated StudioNet GEN only. Submission readiness requires the independent proof verifier to pass.

howTo.heading: Inspect the recorded season
howTo.instruction: Open the website without a wallet. Inspect standings, choose a roster and select a chart week. Recorded proof and live finalized reads have distinct labels.

howTo.heading: Review judgments
howTo.instruction: Open the moment and ruling sections. Follow permanent evidence links and compare the verbatim quote and frozen rule clause. Inspect actual transaction receipts on the proof page.

howTo.heading: Create and draft
howTo.instruction: Connect a StudioNet wallet, create a league with consecutive Saturdays, cards and an editable rulebook, then invite 4–8 players. Start the snake draft once joins and optional entries finalize.

howTo.heading: Score and settle
howTo.instruction: Lock and read a week, claim a moment or challenge a result. Wait for finality and the dispute window before closing. Settle the completed pool, pull a payout and verify the exact native transfer parent and child.

expectedOutcome: A publicly inspectable real replay, with live receipts distinguishing completed outcomes from pending work. The verifier requires all six resolved chart reads, awarded and rejected cards, upheld and overturned disputes, final standings, a settled 40-wei pool and an independently verified credited winner claim. These outcomes are not yet all present.
